comments.renderer-version-pair: T003: pixi-live2d-display 0.5.0-beta is the ONLY published version peering on pixi.js ^7 (verified via npm view: 0.4.0 peers on @pixi/* ^6). PixiJS v8 is unsupported by every published version. Do not bump pixi.js to 8, and do not 'upgrade' pixi-live2d-display to the 0.4.0 stable tag - that is a downgrade to the v6 line and will break the canvas.
comments.engines-note: Next 16 + React 19. Node 20+ required; developed on Node 24. Bumped from Next 15 to clear a high-severity transitive postcss advisory that had no non-major fix.
